instruction: Two changes inside this region of the service window. (1) The small swallow standing on the left end of the stone sill looks like a living bird: turn it into a clearly man-made ornament of the same size and in the same place - a flat cut-out of dark grey sheet metal in the shape of a swallow with a forked tail, a few rivets, a little rust and a chipped wing tip, fixed upright on a small metal foot screwed to the sill. (2) The left casement of the window must be closed: paint the glass of the left pane flush in its white frame, with a faint soft reflection, the hand-repaired wooden birdhouse still visible behind the glass on the inner sill. Keep the stone sill, the frame, the birdhouse and everything around exactly as they are.
